name: Lazarus Pharmacy Counter Technician Uniform
description: Worn by Lazarus pharmacy counter staff in licensed dispensary locations across Tier 2 through Tier 4 districts, this uniform is designed to communicate cleanliness, authority, and approachability in equal measure. A fitted white tunic with a mandarin collar sits over matching straight-leg trousers, both in an antimicrobial polyester-cotton blend that resists contamination from common pharmaceutical compounds. The Lazarus green cross is embroidered at the left chest. A sealed medication-grade pocket runs along the right thigh with a tamper-evident zipper. Subdermal implant clearance is built into the shoulder and forearm panels, and the collar has a small BCI port notch for inventory and dispensing system integration. The fabric self-cleans under UV light, which most Lazarus facilities cycle every six hours.
cultural_context: The white Lazarus tunic is one of the most recognized uniforms in GLMZ. For many Tier 1 and Tier 2 residents, a Lazarus counter tech is the closest thing to accessible medical care they'll see. The uniform carries a weight of institutional trust that individual technicians sometimes find hard to live up to, and occasionally weaponize.
story_hooks: A counter tech has been quietly swapping legitimate prescriptions with placebos for patients flagged in the Ouroboros insurance database — and using the sealed thigh pocket to remove the real medication.
A player needs access to a specific pharmaceutical compound and must either befriend, bribe, or impersonate a Lazarus counter tech.
The UV self-cleaning cycle in a particular Lazarus branch has been modified to also degrade certain augment-related compounds, affecting the medication of specific cyberware users.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A crisp, clinical silhouette that reads as both institutional authority and accessible care. The fitted white tunic creates a clean vertical line broken only by the emblematic green cross at the chest. The mandarin collar sits neat and professional without stiffness. Overall impression: trustworthy, regulated, slightly austere.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not restrictive. The tunic skims the torso without clinging; sleeves taper to the forearm where subdermal clearance panels create subtle reinforced zones. Trousers are straight-leg with a slight taper at the ankle, designed for practicality and movement around a dispensary counter.
physical_description.primary_material: Antimicrobial polyester-cotton blend (65/35 ratio). Treated with self-cleaning photocatalytic coating reactive to UV light.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, medical-grade finish with a subtle matte sheen. Deliberately designed to appear sterile without being cold. The medication-grade pocket on the right thigh has a raised, reinforced texture for durability and tamper-evidence visibility.
physical_description.color_scheme: Pristine white as primary. Lazarus green cross embroidered at left chest (RGB: 34, 139, 34). Small accent stitching in subdued gray along seams and pocket edges.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit tunic (pulls over the head). Trousers feature a discrete friction-sealed waistband with hidden snap closure. The right-thigh medication pocket has a tamper-evident sealed zipper with green indicator stripe running its length.
distinctive_features: Embroidered Lazarus green cross (medical authority marker)
Small BCI port notch at neckline (barely visible, integrated into mandarin collar design)
Reinforced subdermal implant clearance panels at shoulders and forearms (visible as subtle topstitched zones)
Sealed, tamper-evident medication-grade pocket with indicator stripe
Photocatalytic self-cleaning treatment (no visible residue under normal light)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 institutional. Signals regulated employment, access to controlled substances, and licensed medical proximity. A white Lazarus uniform grants entry to spaces that require credentials.
physical_description.cultural_context: The wearer is a gatekeeper to pharmaceutical access across the GLMZ. This uniform carries institutional weight—patients trust it, corps enforce it, and street-level residents see it as a potential resource or barrier depending on their tier. The white tunic is recognized instantly across all districts; wearing it outside a Lazarus facility is conspicuous and consequential.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to barely worn. The photocatalytic coating means even frequent use appears fresh. Fading occurs only after 2-3 years of daily UV cycling. Wear patterns on the tunic are virtually invisible due to the antimicrobial treatment; the medication pocket shows subtle creasing from repeated use but never stains.
